message.content:
This editorial illustration features a man from the chest up, viewed in profile. He has black hair, fair skin, and is sweating profusely. He wears thin-rimmed glasses and holds them with his right hand as he looks toward an eye chart on the right. His mouth is open, and he appears to be straining or speaking. He is dressed in a white button-down shirt.

To the right, a crumpled white paper eye chart is pinned against a light blue background. The chart contains several rows of black capital letters of varying sizes. One row clearly displays the letters "K I P I," though the letters are blurred. The top letter is a large "E."

The masthead "TEMPO" is in large white serif font at the top. Below it, handwritten-style text reads "50 Tahun!". The main headline at the bottom left reads "KIPI SATU HOAKS SERIBU" in bold black capital letters. Smaller text below it begins with "Pemerintah gamang..." Additional text appears at the top and bottom right. A barcode and QR code are in the bottom right corner. A solid red vertical bar runs along the far-left edge.
